spiritgiven.comments: Good game throughout. As we talked about in the spirit circle, a couple of guys whose attitude makes it very difficult to communicate with. Otherwise it’s a good hard fought game.

Thanks for the game, well played. Good hard fought game until the end. A couple of calls in the end that seemed a little unfair and then to hear from the sideline “sorry for the calls” really sucked, slaps x2.
But no hard feelings as you deserved the win. Looking forward to the next.
Took both teams some time to get to know each other. Everything improved during the game and didn’t get heated despite high level of physicality, mostly in the mark from both teams.
Thanks for a great game and communicating concerns during the game.

As we talked about in the circle we both triggered each other in the attitude so it went the wrong way unfortunately. Regarding universe point, regardless if the change of disc to your own is on purpose or not, a check with us is mandatory. You know the disc is changed because the first word after the celebratory spike is “why do you spike our disc”.

spiritreceived.comments: We did consider a 1 for positive attitude, it left us with a sour feeling to be accused of cheating for what we felt were close (but definitely fair) calls. The game overall was good so we didn't let the experience in that one point impact the overall score. Thanks for the game!

One player intentionally bumped violently into one of our player out of frustration. He just received a foul from our player and reacted this way instead of simply calling foul and asking to reduce body contact.
Main issues were discussed in spirit circle, but we took issues with a player being called a cheat, obvious taunting on and off pitch to players and coach, and a couple of particularly reckless bids.
